🚀 Learning Focus

Identify factors that cause rusting and how to prevent it; classify matter; investigate state changes in water and connect evaporation and condensation to cloud and rain formation.

💡

Big Idea (Understanding)

🧲 7.1 Rusting Material

Understanding the factors that cause rusting helps us make informed decisions to protect iron objects, ensure their long-term safety and durability, and reduce waste in everyday life.

Real-life situation: Painting iron gates, lubricating bicycle chains and keeping iron tools dry can help prevent rusting, extend their lifespan and reduce the need for replacements.

🧊 8.1 States of Matter

Understanding the states and properties of matter helps us explain how materials behave and how we use them in everyday life.

Real-life situation: Liquids need containers, solids are suitable for objects that must retain their shape, and gases can fill spaces such as balloons and tyres.

🌧️ 8.2 Changes in States of Matter for Water

Understanding how water changes state helps us explain how heat affects water in everyday life and in natural phenomena.

Real-life situation: Ice melts in a drink, water freezes in a freezer, clothes dry under the sun, droplets appear on a cold glass, and clouds and rain form through changes in water state.

🛡️ Safety first: experiments involving hot water, heat sources, glassware or metal objects must be supervised by a teacher. Do not touch hot equipment or taste experiment materials.
